# Train Distance Calculation

## Given Information
- Speed: 60 km/h
- Time: 2.5 hours

## Formula
$$\text{Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$$

## Calculation
$$\text{Distance} = 60 \text{ km/h} \times 2.5 \text{ h}$$

$$\text{Distance} = 150 \text{ km}$$

## Answer
The train travels **150 kilometres**.
